Second slug 'nahar-spinning-mills-limited' returned 1367 shipments, latest 2025-11-24, but those visible rows are IMPORTS of raw cotton (HS 52010024) from COFCO/Viterra — used only as corroboration of the entity's customs activity, not as export evidence.
domestic_evidence: Screener.in (BSE: 500296, NSE: NAHARSPING) consolidated/standalone P&L: "Mar 2025 (S) Sales 3,285" and "Mar 2026 (S) Sales 3,218" (Rs crore), with quarterly sales of 703–966 crore through Sep 2026 — i.e. large ongoing domestic+export turnover booked in India. Screener summary: "one of the largest cotton yarn manufacturers in India ... ranks among the top 10 spinners in the domestic market and is one of the largest buyers of cotton in India." Note: the annual report does not split domestic vs export in the free view, so the domestic share of that turnover is not publicly quantified here; GSTIN-level turnover band not retrieved (null).
note: HS mismatch: declared 520513/520514 (fine cotton yarn, single, 232.33–714.29 dtex) vs actual shipments 52052310/52052410/52053210 (cotton yarn, other counts) plus knitwear 61033200 — per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection; company retained, actual HS codes recorded. Industry claim 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is wrong: company is a cotton-yarn spinner and knitwear/garment maker (textiles). Role: manufacturer (own spinning/garment units, exports under own name) — not a trader. Export shipments are factual and dated (Feb 2026, Japan/Egypt/USA, with B/L numbers), so export_status = confirmed. Domestic supply is confirmed by booked sales of Rs 3,218–3,285 crore (FY2025/FY2026) and top-10 domestic spinner position; exact domestic/export split and GST turnover band are not public in the sources read (null). No sanctions/court issues were checked in this task (out of scope for shipments role).
